text: Environmental engineering is an interdisciplinary field that focuses on addressing environmental issues and protecting and improving the ecological environment. It integrates knowledge from multiple disciplines such as engineering, ecology, chemistry, biology, and geology. It addresses the contradiction between human activities and the environment by means of technological development, engineering design, and management planning, controlling environmental pollution (such as wastewater, waste gas, and solid waste), restoring damaged ecosystems (such as degraded soil and polluted water bodies), and promoting the realization of sustainable development models. From the operation of urban sewage treatment plants to the purification technology of industrial waste gas, and to the restoration projects for soil heavy metal pollution, all these fall within the application scope of environmental engineering.
